presetHint:
For a new show, use New or duplicate a preset, swap images (logo/background) and items, then Save JSON to reuse it later.
Canvas size is stored per template, so set it under Layout to match your printer.
To share your preset in the built-in list, open a pull request at the preset repository.
imagesHint: Earlier images draw further back. Background stretches to full canvas; logos keep aspect ratio.
layoutHint:
Canvas size is the exact pixel output, so match it to your printer.
With Scale contents on, a resize also rescales everything: X-axis quantities (x / widths / margins / font size) by the width ratio, Y-axis (y / heights / line-height) by the height ratio, so line breaks are preserved.
Margins affect wrap width (e.g. where the big date line breaks).
refHint: Overlay the real ticket image to fine-tune. Not included in the export.
opsBox:
How to
Edit the items, then save as PNG. Drag on the preview (Shift locks the drag to one axis), or select an item and use the arrow keys (Shift = 10px).

Shortcuts (⌘ on Mac)
Ctrl+Z Undo
Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y Redo
Ctrl+C/X/V Copy / cut / paste
Ctrl+D Duplicate
Del Delete
Ctrl+S Save PNG
Ctrl+Shift+S Save JSON
Ctrl+; Toggle guides
histClearConfirm: Clear the undo history? (The current state is kept.)
guideHint:
Drag from a ruler onto the canvas to create a guide.
Drag a guide on the canvas to move it; drag it off the canvas to delete.
Objects snap to guides while dragging (left/center/right · top/middle/bottom; hold Alt to disable).
Ctrl+; toggles visibility.
Guides are never exported.
rulerTip: Drag onto the canvas to create a guide
fontSystemTt: The intended font could not be loaded, so text may render differently from the original.
presetLoadErr: Could not load the presets. Check your connection, or use “Load JSON” to open a file directly.
exportTaint: Export was blocked by an image loaded from another site. Upload the image as a file and try again.
attrHint: Lays out label/value pairs (seat-type, seat, name…) with uniform spacing. Turn on “In stack” in an item’s ⚙ panel, then pick the item it pairs with.
